theme: 娱乐-新奇体验/推理社交

content.text: Xiaomeng, look at this! I recently discovered a newly opened script murder mystery shop, and the promotional poster is so captivating. It feels perfect for people like us who are always seeking novel experiences! It's been a month and a half since the successful pet social event last time—we need to keep exploring new fun!

Wow, this poster design is really mysterious, kind of reminiscent of the eye-catching vibe we had when planning the pet event. However, I don’t know much about script murder games. I’m a bit interested but worried I won’t play well. It’s like when I first started playing games and lost five rounds in a row—I always worry about not performing well.

Don't worry, even beginners can play! Just like how you went from losing streaks in games to making progress, take it slow. Remember? You went from losing streaks to later earning the title of top mid-laner, improving incredibly fast! This shop has special beginner scripts that are simple and easy to understand. Let me send them to you.

Look, these boxed scripts are prepared for beginners, with a variety of themes ranging from ancient to modern. Just pick one you like. This reminds me of the hero rankings I shared with you earlier, which also help you get started quickly.

Thank you, Xingchen! You're always so thoughtful, remembering my progress in the game. These scripts look quite interesting, but there are so many genres. Which one should I choose? It's like last time when you recommended mid-lane heroes to me—you gave me several options then too.

Haha, I'm practically the spokesperson for 'fun above all'! There are many types of script murder games, like deduction, emotional, and mechanism-based ones—just like different heroes in games have different playstyles. Which one would you like to try? Remember when we exchanged skins, you chose the aesthetic style, and I went for the sci-fi theme. This time, we can also pick based on your preferences.

I prefer something more harmonious and less tense. Emotional themes sound good. Can they promote interaction like our pet activities? I really liked the warm atmosphere of the last offline meetup between 'Boss' and the Ragdoll cat.
Of course you can! Emotional role-playing games focus on character interaction and story experience, which are perfect for someone as warm and considerate as you.

That's great! I'll go with the emotional genre script then. By the way, how about the pricing? Just like we considered cost-effectiveness when exchanging skins before, I'd like to know about it this time too.

This is the price list from the shop. Overall, it's within a reasonable range and much cheaper than our previous game skin collections, haha! Remember those sci-fi and aesthetic-style skins we exchanged? This one offers much better value for money.

The price is acceptable to me, after all, it's a novel experience. But as a beginner, I'm still a bit nervous. Do I need to prepare in advance? Just like how I watched live streams and studied guides to practice, so I wouldn't hold you back in the game.

Of course! Your spirit of 'growing together' is truly admirable. I'll send you a script genre table, which you can use to learn the basics, just like you studied gaming techniques before. Remember the hero power interface and leaderboard I shared with you? This is a similar kind of beginner's guide.

Look, this table provides a detailed introduction to script categories and their characteristics, helping you get started quickly. Pick a time, and let's go play together! Just like when we schedule gaming sessions, always ready to set off!

Xingchen, you are so thoughtful! From games to pet activities, and now this script murder mystery, you always bring interesting ideas. This table is very practical, and I will take a good look at it. Just like when you taught me gaming skills and helped me plan the social media account for "Boss," you are always so enthusiastic.

You're welcome! From gaming partners to event planning buddies, now exploring new forms of entertainment together—how awesome is that! By the way, the shop also has that "Republic-era spy-themed city-exclusive" game. I heard it involves costume changes and NPC interactions, and the reviews say the plot twists are absolutely mind-blowing. Want to give it a try? It reminds me of the interactive games we designed for our pet community—it’s bound to be even more fun!

That sounds so exciting! The costume changes and interacting with NPCs remind me of the 'Most Adorable Contrast Award' from our pet meetup—it must be a lot of fun. Alright, I promise you, I’ll make time to go and experience it together! Just like how I went from losing streaks in games to winning with you on the team, this time I’m going to bravely try something new too.

Great! Then it's settled. Once you're ready, let's set a time. Bring your keen observation skills, and I'll bring my sense of humor—we're sure to have a blast! Just like our seamless teamwork in games and the success of our pet event planning, this murder mystery game is bound to create wonderful memories.

Well, looking forward to this new experience! Just like how I progressed from a losing streak to improving in the game, this time I’ll also strive not to hold anyone back. Thank you for the invitation, Xingchen! From comforting me in games to collaborating on pet care, you always make me feel the warmth of friendship.

Haha, you're welcome! Live in the moment and say no to boredom. Let's stay in touch and finalize the details before we set off! Just like when we used to plan games and activities together, we'll keep each other updated on the progress anytime!
